title: Jaxson Dart gets last laugh against blitzing Vikings coach Brian Flores and the ominous blue medical tent
summary: Jaxson Dart was rocked by a Jay Ward blitz in the Giants-Vikings preseason opener, causing another medical evaluation for a concussion and questions about his return to play.

title: Henry Winkler opens up about the unexpected career he considered before becoming an actor
summary: Henry Winkler almost studied to become a child psychologist before transitioning into a career as an actor and finding fame as Fonzie on "Happy Days."

title: Roger Miller given stark choice after getting caught stealing: ‘You can go to jail or you can go in the Army’
summary: Dean Miller says his father joined the Army as a teen after he was caught stealing from a club. The judge then gave him a choice between jail and the Army.

title: Ex-detective who served fraction of 102-year sentence faces new charges after cold case review
summary: Former Los Angeles vice detective Michael Douglas Brambles, paroled in 2020 under California's elderly inmates law, faces new kidnapping charges.

title: Fauci refuses Senate appearance after invoking Fifth Amendment more than 100 times in COVID probe

title: JJ McCarthy considered 'unpredictable' as Vikings hand starting QB role to Kyler Murray: report
